description: Supplier-lot traceability (decision 2026-10-20-documents-lot-trace-supplier-lot): one GET-only SharePoint capture of the Portal's raw-material receiving folder (the ontology.document_fields_coa scope, integrations/capture_sharepoint.py through the GET-only Graph client; scans OCR-read locally) and a GET-only Portal mirror of the trace relations (scripts/eval_lot_trace.py TRACE_RELATIONS: gold and FileMaker receipt lines, receipts, suppliers, purchase orders, the FM PO lines and the gold products), projected together into the check's temporary host state with the host's post-project steps, so each certificate of analysis's lot field links the receipt lines whose supplier_lot_number it states (CertificateOfAnalysis.for_receipt_line, a lead; a supplier lot never matches a PLX lab id or batch code). Measured through the served host (plx.around) for the capture principal: certificates served, with a lot stated and linked to one receipt line or more; receipt lines projected, with a supplier lot and linked; of the linked certificates, how many reach a Supplier (line_of, supplied_by), a PurchaseOrder (line_of, receives on gold; receives_line, line_of on FM) and a Product (for_item, gold only); up to 3 sample traces as line sources and one boolean per hop; leaks: certificates or certificate links served to a principal granted the Portal relations but no SharePoint file, must be 0. Zero certificates fails (--min-documents 1); no linked certificate, or none reaching a Supplier and a PurchaseOrder, fails; a run without the Portal is blocked no_record_source. Counts, booleans and enums only; no names, paths, ids, lots or text.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; its test is injected-transport (ontology/tests/test_lot_trace.py LotTraceLiveCheckTests runs scripts.eval_document_fields_live --lot-trace over the in-process FakeDrive and a fixture Portal, checks this spec's expectations on that output, and that a run whose certificates state no served supplier lot fails them). Captured files and mirrored rows live only in {tmp}/state and are deleted with the check's temporary directory. Unverified live assumptions: the vendor CoAs in Receiving/Raw state the supplier's lot under a label the certificate_of_analysis profile knows; the Portal's gold receipt lines carry supplier_lot_number and FM's raw and packaging receipts lotnoqc in the supplier's own spelling (the lot normaliser upper-cases and trims, nothing more); how many certificates link is measured here, never assumed. FM receipt rows bind no product, so hops.product counts gold traces only.
